description: This PHP class defines an API endpoint for retrieving a list of employee timesheets in the OrangeHRM system's Time module. It handles query parameters for filtering, sorting, and pagination, and returns a collection of EmployeeTimesheetModel instances along with metadata such as total count.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetListAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoint for listing employee timesheets with filtering, sorting, and pagination in the OrangeHRM Time module.
